page_title: CodeMenu — Developer Knowledge Base for Mac

sources.entry: CodeMenu - Advanced snippets manager with IDE integration, natural language search, and more.

summary.name: CodeMenu
summary.one_liner: CodeMenu is a Mac developer knowledge base for storing and organizing code snippets, prompts, images, documents, and scripts, with options to run scripts and preview code.
use_cases: Storing prompts, docs, and images alongside code
Running shell scripts from a central library
Previewing HTML and JavaScript before reuse
Testing regular expressions before committing them
Linking research notes to screenshots or config files
summary.what_it_does: CodeMenu lets users save code, prompts, visuals, docs, and experiments in one library. Spaces isolate snippets by project, while Stashes hold temporary items and Groups and Tags provide broader organization. A visual knowledge graph links related items, such as a database config to its migration script. It renders Markdown with LaTeX, previews images and colors, and highlights syntax for 61 languages, and it can store files such as PDFs and shell scripts. It can also execute shell scripts from the app, preview HTML and JavaScript in a sandboxed web view, and test regular expressions.
notable: Visual knowledge graph linking snippets, notes, and files
Runs shell scripts and previews HTML/JavaScript in a sandboxed web view
Syntax highlighting for 61 languages with Markdown and LaTeX rendering
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Listed as a Mac-only app; no other platforms named
